question: According to the Union Home Ministry, the census 2021 (which got postponed due to COVID 19) was supposed to collect data for ______ for the first time.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Other Backward Castes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The census 2021** was supposed to **collect data for OBCs** for the first time. Previously, only data for Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) were collected separately.
 
• OBCs are social groups that are deemed to be educationally and socially disadvantaged.
